name: heartbeat
description: 2D · near-black background, oversized headline with a bright accent, an ECG line that continues across slides, flat phone with a neon rim.
design_notes: Fitness/health, near-black look. Oversized centered white headline with the key phrase in the accent colour. A thin accent-coloured heartbeat (ECG) line runs horizontally just under the headline and continues seamlessly from slide to slide. The phone is dark with a thin neon rim in the accent colour and a soft glow, front-facing. Minimal, high contrast, no gradients.
